chapter.heading: Impending Judgment on the Earth
chapter.v:
Behold, the
Lord makes the earth empty and makes it waste,Distorts its surfaceAnd scatters abroad its inhabitants. [Dan. 7:1]

And it
shall be:As with the people, so with the priest;As with the servant, so with his master;As with the maid, so with her mistress;As with the buyer, so with the seller;As with the lender, so with the borrower;As with the creditor, so with the debtor. [Neh. 1:1; Esth.]

The land
shall be entirely emptied and utterly plundered,For the Lord has spoken this word. [Dan. 7:5]

The earth
mourns and fades away,The world languishes and fades away;The haughty people of the earth languish.

The earth
is also defiled under its inhabitants,Because they have transgressed the laws,Changed the ordinance,Broken the everlasting covenant. [Dan. 8:8, 21;]

Therefore the
curse has devoured the earth,And those who dwell in it are desolate.Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned,And few men are left.

The new
wine fails, the vine languishes,All the merry-hearted sigh.

The mirth
of the tambourine ceases,The noise of the jubilant ends,The joy of the harp ceases. [Dan. 7:6; 8:22;]

They shall
not drink wine with a song;Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it. [Dan. 11:21] [Dan. 11:25 i Ps.]

The city
of confusion is broken down;Every house is shut up, so that none may go in. [Dan. 11:28 k Is. 14:13; Jer. 48:26] [Rev. 12:4]

There is
a cry for wine in the streets,All joy is darkened,The mirth of the land is gone. [2 Kin. 19:22, 23; 2 Chr. 32:15-17; Is. 37:23; Dan.] [Josh. 5:14 o Ezek. 46:14; Dan. 11:31; 12:11 p Ex. 29:38]

In the
city desolation is left,And the gate is stricken with destruction. [Ps. 119:43; Is. 59:14 s Dan. 8:4;] [Dan. 11:31]

When it
shall be thus in the midst of the land among the people,It shall be like the shaking of an olive tree,Like the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done. [Dan. 4:13, 23; 1 Pet. 1:12]

They shall
lift up their voice, they shall sing;For the majesty of the LordThey shall cry aloud from the sea.

Therefore glorify
the Lord in the dawning light,The name of the Lord God of Israel in the coastlands of the sea. [1 Pet. 1:10] [Ezek. 1:26]

From the
ends of the earth we have heard songs:“Glory to the righteous!”But I said, “I am ruined, ruined!Woe to me!The treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously,Indeed, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.” [Dan. 9:21; Luke 1:19,]

Fear and
the pit and the snareAre upon you, O inhabitant of the earth. [Ezek. 1:28; 44:4; Dan. 2:46; Rev. 1:17]

And it
shall beThat he who flees from the noise of the fearShall fall into the pit,And he who comes up from the midst of the pitShall be caught in the snare;For the windows from on high are open,And the foundations of the earth are shaken. [Dan. 10:9; Luke 9:32 a Ezek. 2:2; Dan. 10:10,]

The earth
is violently broken,The earth is split open,The earth is shaken exceedingly. [Hab. 2:3]

The earth
shall reel to and fro like a drunkard,And shall totter like a hut;Its transgression shall be heavy upon it,And it will fall, and not rise again. [Job 34:20; Lam. 4:6]

It shall
come to pass in that dayThat the Lord will punish on high the host of exalted ones,And on the earth the kings of the earth. [Dan. 11:3]

They will
be gathered together,As prisoners are gathered in the pit,And will be shut up in the prison;After many days they will be punished. [Dan. 11:4]

Then the
moon will be disgracedAnd the sun ashamed;For the Lord of hosts will reignOn Mount Zion and in JerusalemAnd before His elders, gloriously.
